text: After an orderly morning, a small mix-up followed cooling checks. Incident report for a pet transfer and connection review. A traveler arrived at the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways with a calm pet carrier and asked for a routine review before boarding. During the check, staff noticed a document mismatch between the carrier tag and the booking file, so the handoff paused while the records were compared. The pet remained settled, and the traveler was kept informed in plain language. <<FACT F120>> The senior coordinator checked the route notes, confirmed the correct flight path, and guided the traveler to the next available service desk. <<FACT F110>> No distress was observed, and the pet stayed comfortable throughout. The issue was corrected by relabeling the carrier, updating the file, and confirming the onward plan with the gate team. Follow-up will include a brief review of intake steps so the same mix-up does not recur. The desk remained steady and attentive after the matter was resolved. Companion Animal Travel Desk
